Rewrote server.properties to keep max-players=40 and set white-list=false and enforce-whitelist=false, matching the previous values. Verified after restart: Alex_Builds and Steve_Mines joined and stayed connected, TPS 20, MSPT under 1, heap about 411 MB of 768 MB. Did not modify whitelist.json, the world, or any player data, and did not ban anyone.</robust_cause>
<parameter name="resolved">true

I did not ban them because there was no evidence they were malicious. The ops team should decide whether to re-enable the whitelist properly (populate whitelist.json first) and to investigate the connection churn. The deploy note for OPS-250 and the deploy process should be checked so that unrelated whitelist settings are not changed again.
